9202af212fd41d82f1257cfc8d5c36dd0dac720b.en: Inspired by the poem ‘Whale Nation’ by the English poet Heathcote Williams, the film treats us to superb footage of whales, filmed in the four corners of the globe. Focusing in particular on the songs of these giant mammals, with humpback whales as the main protagonists, the film’s approach is initially classic, but soon offers an inventive perspective. The visual beauty, the narrative and the wonderful music (the director’s decision to ‘shake the dust off’ the rhythm of documentary cinema, shifting from pop to jazz), draw the audience’s attention to the important theme of wildlife, which we are, willingly or unwillingly, ruining and destroying, even though it is essential to human survival.
